apply_look_at_transformation: apply a look at transformation to batched 3D vertices using eye, at, and up vectors
create_camera_view_matrix: create a camera view rotation matrix from eye position, target point, and up direction
transform_vertices_to_camera_space: transform 3D vertices into camera space by computing normalized axes and applying rotation
normalize_camera_axes: normalize the z, x, and y camera axes using cross products and F.normalize with eps 1e-5
batch_look_at_for_multiple_views: batch process multiple vertex sets with repeated eye, at, and up vectors for each view
